items.author: lyogavin
items.summary_zh: AirLLM 能在单块 4GB 显存 GPU 上运行 70B 参数的大模型推理，不需要多卡或高显存设备。它显著降低了大模型本地部署的硬件门槛，适合资源有限的开发者尝试超大参数模型。
items.summary_en: AirLLM is an inference project that runs a 70B-parameter model on a single 4GB GPU, avoiding the need for multi-GPU setups. It lowers the hardware barrier for local LLM deployment, making it appealing for developers with limited VRAM.

items.title: zhaoxuya520/reverse-skill
items.description: Reverse Engineering / Authorized Penetration Testing / Security Research Skill Router Pack AI-powered routing + On-demand toolchain bootstrapping + Self-evolving knowledge base Supports Claude Code, Kiro, Cursor, Cline, and other AI coding clients 逆向/渗透/安全技能路由包 - AI 自动路由 + 按需自举工具链 + 自动进化经验库 | 支持 Claude Code / Kiro / Cursor / Cline 等代码 AI 客户端
items.author: zhaoxuya520
items.summary_zh: reverse-skill是一个AI驱动的“技能路由”仓库，面向逆向工程、授权渗透测试和安全研究。它能根据用户请求自动匹配技能、按需搭建工具链，并带有一个自进化的知识库，已支持Claude Code等AI编程环境。适合安全研究者快速实验，但必须确保测试已获合法授权。
items.summary_en: reverse-skill is an AI-powered skill router designed for reverse engineering, authorized penetration testing, and security research. It matches user requests to the right skills, bootstraps toolchains on demand, and includes a self-evolving knowledge base, with support for Claude Code. It's handy for security researchers to run experiments, but authorized use is a must.

items.title: firecrawl/pdf-inspector
items.description: Fast Rust library for PDF inspection, classification, and text extraction. Intelligently detects scanned vs text-based PDFs to enable smart routing decisions.
items.author: firecrawl
items.summary_zh: firecrawl/pdf-inspector 是一个用 Rust 编写的快速 PDF 处理库，支持 PDF 检查、分类和文本提取，并能智能区分扫描版与文本版 PDF，便于下游路由决策。适合需要高吞吐 PDF 处理或搭建文档解析管道的开发者，当前为 GitHub 趋势项目。
items.summary_en: firecrawl/pdf-inspector is a fast Rust library for PDF inspection, classification, and text extraction, with automatic detection of scanned versus text-based PDFs for smarter routing. It suits developers building high-throughput document pipelines. Trending on GitHub today.

items.title: esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix
items.description: DeepSeek-native AI coding agent for your terminal. Engineered around prefix-cache stability — leave it running.
items.author: esengine
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek-Reasonix 是一个面向终端的 AI 编码代理，专为 DeepSeek 模型打造，核心优化点在于 prefix-cache 稳定性，能够长时间保持运行。对于每天使用 DeepSeek 进行编码的开发者，这类设计能减少上下文重复加载，提升持续交互的效率。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek-Reasonix is a terminal-based AI coding agent built natively for DeepSeek models. It's engineered around prefix-cache stability, so it can be left running for long-lived sessions. Developers who use DeepSeek heavily will benefit from fewer redundant context loads and smoother continuous interactions.

items.title: TencentCloud/TencentDB-Agent-Memory
items.description: TencentDB Agent Memory is a team-level memory hub for AI Agents — turning conversations, docs, and code into four reusable memory assets (Chat Memory, Skill, LLM-Wiki, Code-Graph) that are governed, shared, and equipped across agents and frameworks.
items.author: TencentCloud
items.summary_zh: 腾讯云开源了 TencentDB-Agent-Memory，一个面向 AI Agent 团队的记忆中枢，能把对话、文档和代码转成 Chat Memory、Skill、LLM-Wiki、Code-Graph 四类可复用记忆资产。它强调统一治理和团队共享，适合构建多 Agent 协作系统的开发者。
items.summary_en: Tencent Cloud has released TencentDB-Agent-Memory, a team-level memory hub for AI agents. It converts conversations, documents, and code into four reusable assets: Chat Memory, Skill, LLM-Wiki, and Code-Graph. The project focuses on governed, shared memory, making it useful for developers building multi-agent systems that need consistent context and tool knowledge across sessions.

items.title: microsoft/AI-For-Beginners
items.description: 12 Weeks, 24 Lessons, AI for All!
items.author: microsoft
items.summary_zh: 微软推出的《AI for Beginners》课程是一套为期12周、共24课时的免费学习资源，专为零基础学习者设计。课程覆盖机器学习、神经网络、计算机视觉等核心主题，结合实践项目，帮助初学者系统掌握人工智能基础。无论学生还是转行者，都能借此轻松入门AI领域。
items.summary_en: Microsoft's AI for Beginners is a free, structured curriculum that spans 12 weeks with 24 lessons, covering essential AI topics like machine learning, neural networks, and computer vision. It's designed for absolute beginners, offering hands-on projects and clear explanations. This repo makes AI education accessible to everyone, from students to career changers, providing a solid foundation without needing prior experience. It's a perfect starting point for anyone curious about artificial intelligence.

items.title: microsoft/generative-ai-for-beginners
items.description: 21 Lessons, Get Started Building with Generative AI
items.author: microsoft
items.summary_zh: 这是微软发布的开源学习仓库，包含 21 节课程，旨在帮助开发者快速上手生成式 AI 应用开发。适合希望系统掌握生成式 AI 基础、并直接进入实际构建的初学者。
items.summary_en: Microsoft's open-source GitHub repository, generative-ai-for-beginners, provides 21 lessons to help developers start building applications with generative AI. The material is organized as a beginner-friendly curriculum, making it easy to follow sequentially or jump to a specific lesson. This is a practical starting point for developers seeking a structured, hands-on introduction to the field.

items.title: donnemartin/system-design-primer

items.summary_zh: 此仓库是 GitHub 热门的系统设计学习资源，聚焦大规模系统设计与面试准备，并附带 Anki 记忆卡片。适合准备系统设计面试或想系统梳理后端架构知识的开发者。

items.title: shiyu-coder/Kronos
items.description: Kronos: A Foundation Model for the Language of Financial Markets
items.author: shiyu-coder
items.summary_zh: Kronos 是一个专为金融市场设计的基础模型，它能够理解并生成金融领域的专业语言，包括行情数据、财报分析、新闻情绪和技术指标等。不同于通用大语言模型，Kronos 通过学习大量金融文本和历史数据，掌握了市场特有的术语和逻辑，可以辅助量化交易、风险管理和投资研究。对于量化分析师和机构投资者而言，Kronos 有望成为解读市场信号、生成交易策略的新利器。
items.summary_en: Kronos is a foundation model specifically designed for financial markets, capable of understanding and generating the specialized language of finance, including market data, earnings reports, news sentiment, and technical indicators. Unlike general-purpose LLMs, Kronos has been trained on vast amounts of financial texts and historical data, mastering domain-specific terms and logic. It assists quantitative trading, risk management, and investment research. For quantitative analysts and institutional investors, Kronos promises to be a powerful tool for interpreting market signals and generating trading strategies.

items.title: Panniantong/Agent-Reach
items.description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.
items.author: Panniantong
items.summary_zh: Agent-Reach 是一个命令行工具，让 AI 代理能直接读取和搜索 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、Bilibili、小红书等平台，且无需支付 API 费用。它统一了多个信息源，适合构建需要实时网络数据的智能体应用。
items.summary_en: Agent-Reach is a CLI that gives AI agents access to read and search platforms like Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, and XiaoHongShu with zero API fees. It provides a unified interface for real-time web data, useful for developers building agents that need current online information.

items.summary_en: Invidious is an open-source alternative front-end to YouTube that lets you watch videos without ads and tracking, while still supporting subscriptions, playlists, and other core features. It can also be used through Tor or a proxy. This is ideal for privacy-conscious users or anyone who wants to self-host their own YouTube client.

items.summary_en: livekit/agents is a framework for building realtime voice AI agents, with support for audio and video interactions. It abstracts away low-level infrastructure, making it appealing for developers who want to add voice AI to applications quickly.

items.title: usekaneo/kaneo
items.description: 🎯 All you need. Nothing you don't. Open source project management that works for you, not against you.

items.summary_en: Kaneo is an open-source project management tool built on a minimalist philosophy, offering only essential features without unnecessary clutter. It targets developers and small teams who prefer a lightweight, self-hosted alternative to heavier project management suites. The project emphasizes adapting to user workflows rather than forcing users to adapt to the tool.

items.title: jamiepine/voicebox
items.description: The open-source AI voice studio. Clone, dictate, create.
items.author: jamiepine
items.summary_zh: Voicebox 是一个开源的人工智能语音工作室，让你能够轻松克隆声音、进行听写和创作语音内容。它完全本地运行，无需联网，保护了用户隐私。你可以用几分钟的录音样本生成逼真的语音，甚至让 AI 说出原本没有说过的话。对于播客制作者、配音演员、内容创作者和视障人士来说，这个工具既能辅助内容生产，也能作为无障碍阅读助手，极大地降低了语音合成的门槛。
items.summary_en: Voicebox is an open-source AI voice studio that lets you clone voices, dictate text, and create speech content effortlessly. It runs entirely offline, ensuring privacy, and can generate realistic voice output from just a few minutes of audio samples, even making the AI say things it never originally said. Podcasters, voice actors, content creators, and visually impaired users will find it invaluable for production and accessibility, significantly lowering the barrier to professional-grade voice synthesis.

items.description: bluetooth mesh chat, IRC vibes
items.author: permissionlesstech
items.summary_zh: BitChat 是一个基于蓝牙 Mesh 网络的开源聊天工具，它不依赖互联网或中央服务器，设备之间通过蓝牙自动组网实现消息传递，体验类似于早期 IRC 的聊天风格。这个项目解决了在无网络或网络受限环境下保持通信的问题，非常适合户外活动、灾害救援或对隐私要求高的场景。它展示了去中心化通信的另一种可能性。
items.summary_en: BitChat is an open-source chat application built on Bluetooth Mesh, allowing devices to automatically form a network and exchange messages without any internet or central server. Its experience mimics the vibe of classic IRC chats. This project solves the problem of maintaining communication in offline or network-restricted areas, making it ideal for outdoor adventures, disaster response, or privacy-conscious users. It demonstrates a compelling alternative for decentralized messaging.

items.title: diegosouzapw/OmniRoute
items.description: Never stop coding. Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 290+ providers (90+ free), 500+ models — Kimi, Claude, GPT, OpenAI, Gemini, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniMax. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Cline & Copilot. Quota-aware auto-fallback, RTK+Caveman compression saves 15-95% tokens, MCP/A2A, Desktop/PWA. Built by 500+ contributors
items.author: diegosouzapw
items.summary_zh: OmniRoute 是一个免费的开源 AI 网关项目，它提供了一个统一端点，让你能访问超过 290 个提供商（其中 90 多个免费）和 500 多种模型，包括 Kimi、Claude、GPT、Gemini 等主流模型。开发者只需要接入一个 API 就可以调用几乎所有的前沿模型，不再需要为每个服务商单独申请和集成，大大降低了实验和开发的门槛。对于 AI 应用开发者来说，这是一个极大的便利。
items.summary_en: OmniRoute is a free, open-source AI gateway that exposes a single endpoint to access over 290 providers (90+ free) and 500+ models, including Kimi, Claude, GPT, Gemini, and many more. Developers can now call almost any cutting-edge model through one API, eliminating the need for separate integrations and sign-ups. This dramatically lowers the barrier for AI experimentation and development, making it a huge boon for AI application builders.

items.summary_en: Worldmonitor is an AI-powered real-time global intelligence dashboard that aggregates news, monitors geopolitical events, and tracks infrastructure status in a single unified view. Designed for analysts, journalists, and business leaders, it enables rapid situational awareness and informed decision-making by consolidating diverse data streams into an accessible interface. Its significance lies in simplifying complex global monitoring and helping professionals stay ahead of critical developments.

items.title: asgeirtj/system_prompts_leaks
items.description: Extracted system prompts from Anthropic - Claude Fable 5, Opus 5, Claude Design, Claude Code. OpenAI - ChatGPT GPT-5.6-Sol, Codex. Google - Gemini 3.5 Flash, 3.1 Pro, Antigravity. xAI - Grok, Cursor, Copilot, VS Code, Perplexity, and more. Updated regularly.
items.author: asgeirtj
items.summary_zh: asgeirtj/system_prompts_leaks 是一个 GitHub 项目，它收集了 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 多个大模型的系统提示词，包括 Claude Fable 5、Opus 4.8、ChatGPT 5.5 Thinking 等。这些提示词揭示了模型背后如何被引导、如何设定角色和限制，对 AI 研究者和开发者理解模型行为非常有价值。它引发了关于提示工程和模型安全边界的讨论，也是窥探顶级 AI 内部设计的一个窗口。
items.summary_en: This GitHub repository compiles leaked system prompts from popular AI models like Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 and Opus 4.8, as well as OpenAI's ChatGPT 5.5 Thinking and GPT 5.5 Instant. By exposing the hidden instructions that shape how these models behave, it offers rare insight into prompt engineering, safety guardrails, and role-setting techniques. AI researchers and developers can learn how top models are orchestrated, but the leak also raises important questions about access control and intellectual property in the generative AI race.

items.summary_en: Strix is an open-source AI-powered penetration testing tool designed to automatically identify and fix vulnerabilities in applications. By simulating cyber attacks with artificial intelligence, it helps developers catch security flaws early in the development cycle, significantly reducing manual effort and cost. This tool is particularly valuable for startups and individual developers who lack dedicated security teams, offering a practical way to strengthen app security without complex infrastructure. Its open-source nature also allows the community to contribute and customize it for specific needs.

items.summary_en: OpenCut is an open-source video editor designed as a free alternative to CapCut. It offers powerful editing features without any subscription or watermark, making it ideal for content creators who want full control over their tools. The project is cross-platform and community-driven, ensuring transparency and continuous improvement. For anyone tired of paid video editors or restrictive platforms, OpenCut provides a flexible and privacy-respecting solution.

items.summary_en: Appllama is a tool for studying 25,000+ screenshots from top-earning iOS apps, giving designers and product teams a direct look at successful interface patterns. Because the collection is built around screen captures, it works well for visual UX research and competitive teardowns. The tool appears aimed at app professionals who want practical, screen-level references.

items.title: Zinley

items.summary_en: Zinley is a personal AI representative that handles calls, emails, and everyday tasks on your behalf. It's positioned as a central assistant for communication and task management, aiming to save time for busy professionals or independent workers. Public details are limited, so the exact implementation remains unclear, and further evaluation is needed to see how well it performs.

items.title: Capptivo

items.summary_en: Capptivo is a free, open-source screen recorder and demo editor. It targets developers and content creators who need to capture demos and do lightweight video editing without paying for a proprietary tool. The listing gives no further feature details beyond this positioning.

It's aimed at social media users who want their profile link to stand out, although the listing provides no more than this one-line pitch. This may appeal to creators and professionals who care about how their bio links are presented.

items.summary_en: NudgeForMe is an AI follow-up agent for missed email opportunities. If an important email slips through, it automatically drafts and sends a polite nudge on your behalf. Salespeople, freelancers, and busy inbox owners can use it to avoid losing deals to slow or forgotten replies.

Its pitch is letting developers keep up with code tasks from a mobile device rather than being tied to a desktop terminal. The listing is a one-line description, so supported models and setup details aren't specified.

items.title: Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受
items.description: Cursor 让我第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的震撼，Codex 则让我第一次真正感觉到，AI 不只是编程助手，而是一个真正的超级Agent，Codex 明显更接近下一阶段的形态。
items.summary_zh: 一位开发者从Cursor切换到Amazon Codex使用了半个多月，分享了两者的本质差异。Cursor让他第一次感受到AI编程的震撼，但Codex让他真正觉得AI不再只是辅助工具，而是一个能独立执行任务的超级Agent。作者认为Codex更接近下一阶段AI编程的形态，从对话式补全进化到主动式代理，对追求最前沿编程体验的开发者有重要参考价值。
items.summary_en: After switching from Cursor to Amazon Codex for over half a month, a developer shared their real experience of the fundamental differences. While Cursor first impressed them with AI-assisted coding, Codex felt like a true super agent that can independently execute tasks, not just an assistant. The author believes Codex represents the next phase of AI programming—evolving from conversational completion to proactive agency. This comparison is invaluable for developers seeking the cutting edge in AI-powered coding tools.

items.title: 写给年轻程序员的几点建议-2

items.summary_zh: 作者针对互联网红利消退的现状，向年轻程序员提出培养商业嗅觉和写作能力的建议。他认为在中国庞大的人口基数下，能卖爆一个商品或写出高阅读量的公众号文章就能获得巨大财富。文章强调技术之外的市场认知和内容表达能力同样重要，适合处于职业早期的程序员思考如何拓宽收入来源。
items.summary_en: The author offers advice for young programmers in the post-internet-bonus era, emphasizing the need to develop business acumen and writing skills. Given China's huge population, successfully selling a product or writing a viral WeChat article can bring significant wealth. The article argues that market insight and content communication are as crucial as technical skills, making it relevant for early-career programmers looking to diversify their income streams.

items.title: 小程序上线半年我赚了多少钱？

items.summary_zh: 一位独立开发者分享了他业余开发的记账小程序“福猪记账”上线半年来的真实收入与运营数据。从v1.0.0迭代到v1.6.1，他记录了开发日志、用户增长曲线和盈利情况。这篇文章不仅展示了个人开发者利用业余时间做产品的可能性，也提供了从零到一、从技术到商业的完整复盘，特别适合想试试副业的程序员参考。
items.summary_en: An indie developer shared the real revenue and operational data of his expense tracking mini-program called 'Fuzhu' over six months since launch. He iterated from v1.0.0 to v1.6.1, documenting development logs, user growth, and profitability. This article demonstrates the possibility of building a product in spare time, offering a complete postmortem from coding to business. It’s especially useful for programmers exploring side projects.

items.title: 🚀 2026 年 6 月 GitHub 十大热门项目排行榜 🔥
items.description: 欢迎来到 2026 年 6 月 GitHub 热门开源项目排行榜！聚焦 Agent 感知 + 技能市场 + 视频生产 + 代码智能 + 并行编排五大主线！
items.summary_zh: 文章盘点了2026年6月GitHub上最热门的十大开源项目，聚焦五大技术主线：Agent感知、技能市场、视频生产、代码智能和并行编排。这些项目反映了当前AI和开发者工具领域的最新趋势，例如自主智能体框架、去中心化技能交易平台、AI视频生成工具、代码补全与审查增强插件，以及并行计算调度方案。对于希望紧跟开源前沿的开发者，这篇榜单提供了一份值得关注的项目清单。
items.summary_en: This article highlights the top ten trending open source projects on GitHub in June 2026, organized around five key themes: agent perception, skill marketplaces, video production, code intelligence, and parallel orchestration. The projects showcase cutting-edge developments in AI agents, decentralized skill trading platforms, AI-powered video generation, smart code completion and review tools, and high-performance parallel scheduling frameworks. For developers who want to stay ahead of the open source curve, this curated list offers a valuable snapshot of where the ecosystem is heading.

items.title: 最近公司烧token比招员工还贵，老板干懵了...
items.description: 如题。 这真的没在开玩笑。 这也是最近不少公司，在大力、甚至全面拥抱 AI 之后所发出的切实吐槽。 一个月前，Uber 的 CTO 曾对外透露，公司自部署 CC 以来，内部有超 9 成的工程师在高频率
items.summary_zh: 这不是段子，是真实发生在许多公司里的窘境。随着全面拥抱AI，员工高频调用大模型API，公司的token消耗费用竟然超过了招聘新员工的成本。Uber的CTO曾透露，内部有超过九成的工程师在频繁使用AI服务。老板们面对账单直呼头疼：本来是降本增效的AI，怎么成了新的烧钱黑洞？
items.summary_en: This isn't a joke—it's a real dilemma many companies are facing. After wholeheartedly adopting AI, their token usage costs have actually surpassed the expense of hiring new employees. Uber's CTO revealed that over 90% of their engineers are using AI services heavily. Bosses are staring at the bills in shock: the technology that was supposed to reduce costs and boost efficiency has instead become a new money-burning black hole.

items.title: Kimi K3太牛了！但老板说API太贵，让我本地化部署，我算完成本，他涨红脸沉默不语了！其实成本不高，三千万足矣。
items.description: 我看着老板的脸色由白转红，又有点儿紫，最后有点儿黑，没说一句话。沉默良久以后老板开口说：小X啊，这个事儿公司需要开会讨论一下，你把材料留下先回去吧。走出办公室的一刻，我看着老板拿起那份账单...
items.summary_zh: 文章讲述了一位程序员因公司使用Kimi K3 API成本过高，被老板要求研究本地化部署方案。他精心计算后，发现搭建一套能够承载同等性能的本地系统其实需要三千万人民币，而不是老板想象的低成本。当他把账单放在桌上，老板的脸色从白转红、再转紫最后变黑，沉默良久后让员工先回去等开会讨论。这个故事生动揭示了AI大模型商用部署的现实困境：看似便宜的API背后隐藏着高昂的调用成本，而自建基础设施的门槛更是高得惊人。
items.summary_en: This story recounts a programmer who was asked by his boss to explore local deployment of Kimi K3 after the API costs proved too expensive. After careful calculation, he discovered that building an on-premise system matching the same performance would actually cost 30 million yuan—far more than the boss expected. When he presented the bill, the boss's face turned from white to red, then purplish, and finally black; after a long silence, he told the employee to leave the documents and wait for a meeting. The tale vividly illustrates the harsh reality of deploying large AI models commercially: low API prices hide huge cumulative costs, while self-hosting demands astronomical investment.

items.title: 程序员副业 | 2026年4月复盘
items.description: 我看后台有人催更，确实很久没写复盘了，年后一直在折腾，今天有时间，来复盘下4月份做的事情吧，最近真的是疯狂在通宵编程哈哈，今天我开发的软件发布了新版本，稍微可以清闲一下。
items.summary_zh: 这是一位程序员分享的2026年4月副业复盘，作者回应读者催更，讲述了自己年后持续折腾、通宵编程开发软件并发布新版本的经历。文章展现了副业程序员面临的巨大时间投入与自我驱动力，同时也描述了新版本上线后的短暂轻松。对于同样在探索副业的开发者来说，这篇复盘既是一种共鸣，也是激励——持续投入终会带来可见的成果。
items.summary_en: A programmer shares their side project recap for April 2026, responding to readers who urged an update. The author describes an intense period of coding overnight after the new year, finally releasing a new version of their software. This post highlights the significant time commitment and self-discipline required for side projects, along with the fleeting relief of shipping a release. For developers juggling side hustles, this recap resonates deeply—it shows that sustained effort eventually pays off with tangible progress and a momentary break.

items.title: 面试官问你：“AI 能写 80% 的代码了，公司为什么还需要你？”
items.description: 先说一个事实：2026 年的技术面试，已经和两年前完全不一样了。两年前面试问的是："手写一个 Promise"、"说说 React Fiber 原理"...现在面试官默认你会用 AI。他们真正想知道的
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章探讨了在AI能写出80%代码的背景下，技术面试如何从考察基础原理转向考察程序员的独特价值。面试官默认你熟悉AI工具，他们更看重问题拆解、业务理解、架构思维和人机协作能力，提醒开发者要聚焦AI无法替代的核心竞争力。
items.summary_en: The article explores how technical interviews have transformed as AI now writes 80% of the code. Interviewers assume proficiency with AI tools and instead evaluate skills that make developers irreplaceable: problem decomposition, business understanding, architectural thinking, and effective human-AI collaboration. It cautions against over-reliance on AI-generated code and urges developers to cultivate uniquely human competencies for long-term career relevance.

items.title: 三年了，为什么 AI 应用还没爆发？
items.description: 最近meta讲了个算力过剩的鬼故事，AI 股市应声暴跌，大家都很焦虑。 都在问这场 AI 游戏还能不能继续，AI 应用到底什么时候爆发，AI的抖音微信小红书什么时候才出现，AI会不会重蹈 2000 年
items.summary_zh: Meta 提出算力过剩观点后 AI 股市应声下跌，引发行业焦虑。文章反思 AI 应用三年未爆发的原因：基础设施投入巨大但 killer app 缺失，用户对 ChatGPT 等工具的新鲜感消退，而企业级落地面临成本和安全挑战。作者认为 AI 不会重蹈互联网泡沫，但需要找到像抖音微信那样的超级场景才能引爆下一波增长。
items.summary_en: When Meta suggested there was too much computing capacity, AI stocks tumbled, revealing deep anxiety in the industry. This article reflects on why AI applications haven't exploded after three years: massive infrastructure spending without a killer app, declining novelty of chatbots like ChatGPT, and enterprise deployment hurdles around cost and security. The author argues it's not a repeat of the 2000 dot-com bubble, but AI needs its own TikTok or WeChat moment to trigger the next growth wave. It's a sobering reality check for the industry.

items.title: 携程员工：在携程4年，月薪3万左右，基本没涨薪了。不过挺满足的，毕竟稳定，福利也不错（附Agent面试题）

The post also includes detailed source-level answers to 14 Coding Agent interview questions, covering prompt assembly, three-layer context compression, the difference between tools and skills, multi-agent orchestration, and plan design. Developers prepping for AI agent roles will find this a valuable reference.

The author humorously dubs it an "AI shady contractor team," emphasizing that it allows coders on a tight budget to enjoy AI efficiency boosts without expensive subscriptions. It's especially practical for indie developers and small teams.

digest_items.title: 面试官问你：“AI 能写 80% 的代码了，公司为什么还需要你？”
digest_items.description: 先说一个事实：2026 年的技术面试，已经和两年前完全不一样了。两年前面试问的是："手写一个 Promise"、"说说 React Fiber 原理"...现在面试官默认你会用 AI。他们真正想知道的
digest_items.summary_zh: 这篇文章探讨了在AI能写出80%代码的背景下，技术面试如何从考察基础原理转向考察程序员的独特价值。面试官默认你熟悉AI工具，他们更看重问题拆解、业务理解、架构思维和人机协作能力，提醒开发者要聚焦AI无法替代的核心竞争力。
digest_items.summary_en: The article explores how technical interviews have transformed as AI now writes 80% of the code. Interviewers assume proficiency with AI tools and instead evaluate skills that make developers irreplaceable: problem decomposition, business understanding, architectural thinking, and effective human-AI collaboration. It cautions against over-reliance on AI-generated code and urges developers to cultivate uniquely human competencies for long-term career relevance.

digest_items.title: 写给年轻程序员的几点建议-2
digest_items.description: 现在互联网红利已经消失了，深知年轻程序员的不易，下面就浅薄地谈几点建议。中国人口基数比较大，要培养自己的 商业嗅觉。你能卖爆一个商品，就能获得巨大的财富。微信公众号如果能写出 几万 浏览量的文章，就有
digest_items.summary_zh: 作者针对互联网红利消退的现状，向年轻程序员提出培养商业嗅觉和写作能力的建议。他认为在中国庞大的人口基数下，能卖爆一个商品或写出高阅读量的公众号文章就能获得巨大财富。文章强调技术之外的市场认知和内容表达能力同样重要，适合处于职业早期的程序员思考如何拓宽收入来源。
digest_items.summary_en: The author offers advice for young programmers in the post-internet-bonus era, emphasizing the need to develop business acumen and writing skills. Given China's huge population, successfully selling a product or writing a viral WeChat article can bring significant wealth. The article argues that market insight and content communication are as crucial as technical skills, making it relevant for early-career programmers looking to diversify their income streams.

digest_items.title: 程序员副业 | 2026年4月复盘
digest_items.description: 我看后台有人催更，确实很久没写复盘了，年后一直在折腾，今天有时间，来复盘下4月份做的事情吧，最近真的是疯狂在通宵编程哈哈，今天我开发的软件发布了新版本，稍微可以清闲一下。
digest_items.summary_zh: 这是一位程序员分享的2026年4月副业复盘，作者回应读者催更，讲述了自己年后持续折腾、通宵编程开发软件并发布新版本的经历。文章展现了副业程序员面临的巨大时间投入与自我驱动力，同时也描述了新版本上线后的短暂轻松。对于同样在探索副业的开发者来说，这篇复盘既是一种共鸣，也是激励——持续投入终会带来可见的成果。
digest_items.summary_en: A programmer shares their side project recap for April 2026, responding to readers who urged an update. The author describes an intense period of coding overnight after the new year, finally releasing a new version of their software. This post highlights the significant time commitment and self-discipline required for side projects, along with the fleeting relief of shipping a release. For developers juggling side hustles, this recap resonates deeply—it shows that sustained effort eventually pays off with tangible progress and a momentary break.

digest_items.title: 最近公司烧token比招员工还贵，老板干懵了...
digest_items.description: 如题。 这真的没在开玩笑。 这也是最近不少公司，在大力、甚至全面拥抱 AI 之后所发出的切实吐槽。 一个月前，Uber 的 CTO 曾对外透露，公司自部署 CC 以来，内部有超 9 成的工程师在高频率
digest_items.summary_zh: 这不是段子，是真实发生在许多公司里的窘境。随着全面拥抱AI，员工高频调用大模型API，公司的token消耗费用竟然超过了招聘新员工的成本。Uber的CTO曾透露，内部有超过九成的工程师在频繁使用AI服务。老板们面对账单直呼头疼：本来是降本增效的AI，怎么成了新的烧钱黑洞？
digest_items.summary_en: This isn't a joke—it's a real dilemma many companies are facing. After wholeheartedly adopting AI, their token usage costs have actually surpassed the expense of hiring new employees. Uber's CTO revealed that over 90% of their engineers are using AI services heavily. Bosses are staring at the bills in shock: the technology that was supposed to reduce costs and boost efficiency has instead become a new money-burning black hole.

digest_items.summary_zh: 这篇文章从支付宝体验技术部解散说起，讨论“前端已死”背后的真实趋势，并给出前端转 AI 全栈的学习路线。作者认为前端作为独立工种不会消失，但技能栈需要重构，还分享了具体的项目实践建议。适合因为裁员焦虑的前端开发者读一读。
digest_items.summary_en: This article uses the disbanding of Alipay's Experience Technology Department to analyze the real trend behind the 'frontend is dead' claim, then maps out a learning path from frontend to AI full-stack development. The author argues that frontend as a separate job won't vanish but its skill stack must be rebuilt, and offers concrete project suggestions. It's a useful read for frontend developers anxious about layoffs.

digest_items.summary_en: This article highlights the top ten trending open source projects on GitHub in June 2026, organized around five key themes: agent perception, skill marketplaces, video production, code intelligence, and parallel orchestration. The projects showcase cutting-edge developments in AI agents, decentralized skill trading platforms, AI-powered video generation, smart code completion and review tools, and high-performance parallel scheduling frameworks. For developers who want to stay ahead of the open source curve, this curated list offers a valuable snapshot of where the ecosystem is heading.
